variants-b054943a-overview.label: Generated variants and node continuity
variants-b054943a-overview.summary: Source pinned to commit b054943aef9f21281cb7d0ee35fe5c0aa700cb15 (2026-10-22), feat: generate and review persistent subtree variants with node continuity. Implemented behavior documented in b054943a: independent retained candidates, logical identities, review and persistence.

originalLines: ## Generated variants and node continuity
The prompt composer can generate 1–4 independently retained alternatives for a
selected subtree or the complete diagram. Generation stores candidates without
changing live content. The Variants section supports naming, preview, refinement,
per-node accept/reject, application, and removal. Refinement advances just that
variant's head and resets its review decisions. Previous generated revisions
remain retained.
`DiagramVariant` in `domain/core/diagrams/diagramVariant.ts` stores:
- `diagramId`, `contentId`, and `ownerNodeId`: logical ownership; `root` denotes
the complete diagram without requiring an extra visible ASCII node.
- `baseRevisionId`, `headRevisionId`, and `revisionIds`: immutable source,
current candidate, and retained generated revisions.
- `decisions`: accept/reject keyed by stable logical node identity.
- `appliedRevisionId` and `appliedReview`: the last application and the exact
candidate/decisions used, so later review changes can reverse prior changes.
- `id`, `name`, and `prompt`: the independently editable alternative's metadata.
Variants live in `MappingGridDocument.variants`. The checkpoint codec stores each
variant under its own `document/variants` record boundary. `checkpointRevisionIds`
includes variant references as well as current placements, so detached candidates
survive workspace persistence, checkpoint publication, undo/redo, and ChangeSession
fork/acceptance. Variant-only proposal edits appear as document changes. Removing
a variant leaves ordinary retained history available; it does not erase history.
### Continuity protocol
`diagramEditRuntime.ts` supplies the generator with the base revision's `nodeRefs`
and requests `[[keep:logical-node-id]]` suffixes for retained nodes, including
renamed or moved nodes. `diagramNodeContinuity.ts` validates and strips these
annotations before source mapping validation and persistence. Unknown IDs,
duplicate claims, and claims that do not identify exactly one output node fail.
The selected subtree root must retain its logical ID. No label-matching heuristic
establishes identity.
`DiagramRevisionEditor` accepts the validated correspondence for both replacement
and patch operations. Unchanged lines outside a patch retain their existing
identities. `DiagramService` issues all revisions and IDs; reviewed application
uses `derive` to preserve proven identities from the base, candidate, and current
revision. Controller reconciliation uses that correspondence to retain connections,
highlights, selection identity, and folded branches during variant application.
### Selective application and rollback
`variantChanges` compares labels, parents, and ordered children by stable node ID.
Pending and rejected changes retain the base state; accepted changes use the
candidate state. Additions, deletions, and moves can require matching parent/child
decisions. The review UI reports inconsistent structural decisions and blocks
application until they agree.
`applyVariant` performs a three-way merge into the current subtree. Label, parent,
and child-list fields merge separately. Unrelated edits elsewhere, including
unrelated fields inside the subtree, are preserved. A competing edit to a field
being changed raises `VARIANT_CONFLICT`. No-content-conflict applications preserve
existing formatting when topology is unchanged; structural changes render the
reviewed subtree using canonical ASCII connectors and leave surrounding lines
untouched. After applying, change decisions and apply again to reverse selected
updates, subject to the same conflict checks. Undo/redo includes variant metadata
and applications.
The generation API's `variant: {name, count, variantId?}` option supports new
alternatives or refinement of one saved alternative. The canvas API provides
`nodes.variants({nodeId})` and `nodes.reviewVariant({nodeId, variantId, decisions?,
name?, remove?, apply?})`. Review mutations use the existing expected-version,
request deduplication, batching, and persistence mechanisms.

variants-b054943a-boundaries.label: Current boundaries
variants-b054943a-boundaries.summary: Source pinned to commit b054943aef9f21281cb7d0ee35fe5c0aa700cb15 (2026-10-22), feat: generate and review persistent subtree variants with node continuity. Independent simultaneous variant placements and detailed variant ChangeSession UI are follow-ups at this commit. Linked-plan coordination in the diagram is broader than the implemented feature.

originalLines: ### Current boundaries
Candidates still hold complete diagram revisions with a validated subtree scope;
shared content is deduplicated by the persistence codec. Per-node review requires
a tree diagram. Unstructured diagrams support a whole-content review decision.
Formatting-only changes to a tree are not separate review hunks. Structural
application refuses layouts containing non-node prose that it cannot safely
reposition, rather than dropping that text.
Variants are reviewed off-canvas and applied into an existing diagram placement.
Independent simultaneous placements of different variants still require separate
binding identities: current placements share `scene.contents[contentId]`. Switching
between conflicting alternatives requires reversing the prior review first or
resolving the conflicting live edit. Cross-canvas source/search discovery of
unplaced candidates and a detailed variant-specific ChangeSession diff UI remain
follow-ups. Persisted logical IDs are unchanged; shortening them is a separate
migration.

variants-b054943a-model.label: DiagramVariant / variantRange
variants-b054943a-model.summary: Source pinned to commit b054943aef9f21281cb7d0ee35fe5c0aa700cb15 (2026-10-22), feat: generate and review persistent subtree variants with node continuity. Variant schema, root/subtree ownership, retained revision references, validation and selected subtree scope.

originalLines: export const diagramVariantSchema = z.object({
id, name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120), diagramId: id, contentId: id,
/** 'root' is the synthetic owner of the complete diagram. */
ownerNodeId: id, baseRevisionId: id, headRevisionId: id,
revisionIds: z.array(id).min(1).max(1000),
prompt: z.string().max(20000),
decisions: z.record(id, z.enum(['accept', 'reject'])),
/** Last installation, used as the three-way base when changing review decisions. */
appliedRevisionId: id.optional(),
appliedReview: z.object({ headRevisionId: id, decisions: z.record(id, z.enum(['accept', 'reject'])) }).strict().optional()
}).strict();
export type DiagramVariant = z.infer<typeof diagramVariantSchema>;
export type VariantDecision = 'accept' | 'reject';
interface NodeState { label: string; parentId?: string; childIds: string[] }
type Tree = Record<string, NodeState>;
export interface VariantChange { id: string; label: string; kind: 'added' | 'removed' | 'updated'; before?: NodeState; after?: NodeState }
const same = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
const rootId = '$root';
export function variantRevisionIds(variant: DiagramVariant) {

return [...new Set([variant.baseRevisionId, variant.headRevisionId, ...variant.revisionIds, ...(variant.appliedRevisionId ? [variant.appliedRevisionId] : []), ...(variant.appliedReview ? [variant.appliedReview.headRevisionId] : [])])];
export function validateVariant(variant: DiagramVariant, get: (id: string) => DiagramRevision) {
diagramVariantSchema.parse(variant);
if (!variant.revisionIds.includes(variant.headRevisionId)) throw Error('Variant head is not retained');
const base = get(variant.baseRevisionId);
for (const id of variantRevisionIds(variant)) {
const revision = get(id);
if (!revision || revision.diagramId !== variant.diagramId || revision.diagram.id !== variant.contentId) throw Error('Invalid variant revision');
scopedTree(revision, variant.ownerNodeId);
if (variant.ownerNodeId !== 'root' && variant.revisionIds.includes(id))
subtreeReplacement(base.diagram, revision.diagram.content.ascii, variantRange(base, variant.ownerNodeId));
const changes = variantChanges(get(variant.baseRevisionId), get(variant.headRevisionId), variant.ownerNodeId);
if (Object.keys(variant.decisions).some(id => !changes.some(change => change.id === id))) throw Error('Unknown variant review change');
if (variant.appliedReview) approvedTree({ ...variant, ...variant.appliedReview }, base, get(variant.appliedReview.headRevisionId));
export function variantRange(revision: DiagramRevision, owner: string) {
if (owner === 'root') return { startLine: 1, endLine: revision.diagram.content.ascii.split('\n').length };
const parsed = Object.entries(revision.nodeRefs).find(([, ref]) => ref === owner)?.[0];
if (!parsed) throw Error('VARIANT_SCOPE: subtree owner no longer exists');
return diagramSubtreeRange(revision.diagram, parsed);

variants-b054943a-review.label: variantChanges / applyVariant
variants-b054943a-review.summary: Source pinned to commit b054943aef9f21281cb7d0ee35fe5c0aa700cb15 (2026-10-22), feat: generate and review persistent subtree variants with node continuity. Per-logical-node decisions, structural dependency checks and field-level three-way conflict checks. Root application also uses review/merge; it is not a simple revision pointer swap.

originalLines: export function variantChanges(base: DiagramRevision, candidate: DiagramRevision, owner: string): VariantChange[] {

if (base.diagramId !== candidate.diagramId || base.diagram.content.structure.kind !== candidate.diagram.content.structure.kind) throw Error('Variant must preserve diagram identity and structure kind');
const before = scopedTree(base, owner), after = scopedTree(candidate, owner);
return [...new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(after)])].filter(id => !same(before[id], after[id])).map(id => ({
id, label: id === rootId ? 'Subtree structure / content' : after[id]?.label ?? before[id].label,
kind: !before[id] ? 'added' : !after[id] ? 'removed' : 'updated', before: before[id], after: after[id]
function checkTree(tree: Tree) {
const visited = new Set<string>();
const visit = (id: string, parentId?: string, depth = 0) => {
const node = tree[id];
if (!node || visited.has(id) || node.parentId !== parentId || depth > 100) throw Error('REVIEW_DEPENDENCY: accept or reject the related parent, child and move changes together');
visited.add(id); node.childIds.forEach(child => visit(child, id, depth + 1));
visit(rootId);
if (visited.size !== Object.keys(tree).length) throw Error('REVIEW_DEPENDENCY: a retained node would be disconnected; review its parent change');
function approvedTree(variant: DiagramVariant, base: DiagramRevision, candidate: DiagramRevision) {
const result = structuredClone(scopedTree(base, variant.ownerNodeId));
for (const change of variantChanges(base, candidate, variant.ownerNodeId)) if (variant.decisions[change.id] === 'accept') {
if (change.after) result[change.id] = structuredClone(change.after); else delete result[change.id];
checkTree(result); return result;
export function reviewVariant(variant: DiagramVariant, get: (id: string) => DiagramRevision) {
const base = get(variant.baseRevisionId), candidate = get(variant.headRevisionId);
const changes = variantChanges(base, candidate, variant.ownerNodeId);
let error: string | undefined;
try { approvedTree(variant, base, candidate); } catch (e) { error = String(e instanceof Error ? e.message : e); }
const scopeLabel = variant.ownerNodeId === 'root' ? 'Whole diagram'
: diagramContentNodes(base.diagram.content).find(node => base.nodeRefs[node.id] === variant.ownerNodeId)?.label ?? 'Subtree';
return { changes, error, scopeLabel, ascii: candidate.diagram.content.ascii };
/** Three-way application touches only changed logical nodes in the chosen subtree. */
export function applyVariant(variant: DiagramVariant, current: DiagramRevision, diagrams: DiagramService) {
validateVariant(variant, id => diagrams.getRevision(id));
if (current.diagramId !== variant.diagramId || current.diagram.id !== variant.contentId) throw Error('Variant belongs to another diagram');
const base = diagrams.getRevision(variant.baseRevisionId), candidate = diagrams.getRevision(variant.headRevisionId);
const desired = approvedTree(variant, base, candidate);

const before = variant.appliedReview ? approvedTree({ ...variant, ...variant.appliedReview }, base, diagrams.getRevision(variant.appliedReview.headRevisionId)) : scopedTree(base, variant.ownerNodeId);
const live = scopedTree(current, variant.ownerNodeId), merged = structuredClone(live);
for (const id of new Set([...Object.keys(before), ...Object.keys(desired)])) {
if (same(before[id], desired[id])) continue;
// Fields merge separately, so a label review does not overwrite newly added children.
const from = before[id], to = desired[id], now = live[id];
if (from && to && now) {
for (const field of ['label', 'parentId', 'childIds'] as const) if (!same(from[field], to[field])) {
if (!same(now[field], from[field]) && !same(now[field], to[field])) throw Error(`VARIANT_CONFLICT: ${now.label} changed since this review`);
(merged[id] as any)[field] = structuredClone(to[field]);
} else {
if (!same(now, from) && !same(now, to)) throw Error(`VARIANT_CONFLICT: ${to?.label ?? from?.label ?? id} changed since this review`);
if (to) merged[id] = structuredClone(to); else delete merged[id];
checkTree(merged);
if (same(merged, live)) return { diagram: current.diagram, revision: current, nodeIds: new Map(Object.keys(current.nodeRefs).map(id => [id, id])) };
